title: ReviewRoundRequest
description: What a round's review works from: the slice, the test files the builder may not change, the practices files, the interface files to hash at the round's head, and where the rounds stand.

fixed.description: The test files the slice's fails-first items name.

practices.description: The practices files, relative to the project, from forge's settings.

interface.description: The interface files the slice builds against, whose hashes at the round's head the merge card compares with the base.

state.description: Where the rounds stand, as rounds.json gives it.

rules.description: The rules of the committed design that the slice's actions apply, as the slice request carries them; handed on to the reviewer. Empty when it carries none.
